rule: No unowned contract or authority change is implemented by this source node.

job_commands: Attempt start integration-stops until P1 returns AttemptStartBinding
host_rpc: validated host_request dispatch to injected durable handlers
request-bound result validation before the P2 success write
host_replay passthrough because P2 already sends the durable frame
batch dispatch integration-stops without a non-destructive P2 disposition port

gaps.evidence: Frozen wire params contain no provenance_receipt, while ExecutionAuthority.complete_attempt requires provenance_receipt with no default.
gaps.required_resolution: Publish an internal receipt resolution/terminal request seam owned by P1; do not synthesize provenance lineage in this adapter.

gaps.slice: host.job.event/v1, host.job.await_user/v1 and Job cancel/pause/resume/retry mutations
gaps.evidence: Accepted ExecutionAuthority exposes no authoritative methods for these atomic mutations.
gaps.required_resolution: Publish transaction-owning P1 methods; raw adapter SQL and a second ledger remain forbidden.

gaps.evidence: ExecutionAuthority.create_from_verified_snapshot returns only the winning row and cannot distinguish same-job-id concurrent create from replay.
gaps.required_resolution: Return an atomic created/replayed disposition from the P1 transaction. Until then JobCommandResult.replayed is true only when provable and otherwise null; it never claims false.

gaps.evidence: ExecutionAuthority.start_attempt returns None and may replace the requested epoch 1 with the Step-allocated epoch.
gaps.required_resolution: The P1 start transaction must return an immutable AttemptStartBinding containing exact Job/Step/Attempt/worker/release/generation, allocated lease_epoch, receipt ID and result contract. The adapter stops before writing when this port is absent.

gaps.slice: outbound job.start/job.resume/job.pause/job.cancel and Host error replies
gaps.evidence: PluginProcessSupervisor exposes neither request_worker nor respond_host_error; only private session machinery exists.
gaps.required_resolution: Publish lifecycle-locked request_worker and validated Host error response ports.

gaps.evidence: PluginProcessSupervisor.drain_events clears the entire in-memory batch before a handler outcome is known.
gaps.required_resolution: Publish lifecycle-fenced peek_host_events and durable dispose_host_event semantics. Failed and trailing events must remain pending; disposal occurs only after the canonical success frame is retained/written.

gaps.slice: request-bound transaction, one-shot secrets and response reconciliation
gaps.evidence: The accepted handlers have no transaction callback for pre-commit request/result binding, and outbound start has no secret scrub or response-deduplication seam.
gaps.required_resolution: Compose each durable handler as a side-effect-free PreparedHostRpcResult plus a transaction commit callback; the adapter validates mirrored request/result fields before invoking commit. Supply secrets only after AttemptStartBinding, scrub after one send, and reconcile responses by method, attempt_id, allocated lease_epoch and canonical payload hash.

gaps.slice: public Job HTTP route and mutation matrix
gaps.evidence: No accepted list/snapshot routes, operation-key placement, or stale/terminal HTTP mapping are frozen; legacy frontend assumptions return a different DTO.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze the P0 route, DTO and error mapping before mounting this framework-neutral adapter.

gaps.evidence: The accepted baseline has no checkpoint/stream authority mounted in the Job repository.
gaps.required_resolution: Compose a JobSnapshotExtensionReader returning typed JobCheckpointBinding and JobStreamHighWaterBinding values. The adapter verifies checkpoint contract/Attempt ownership plus Workspace/Job/Step scope, stream uniqueness and canonical order.
